subject: Add RDP multi-monitor spanning and credential resolver
body:
Add RDP multi-monitor spanning and credential resolver

New features:
- RDP 'Span All Screens' connects across all monitors using UseMultimon
- Added to context menu under 'Connect (with options)'
- Added to Tools menu as 'RDP Span All Screens'
- Calculates total bounding rectangle of all screens for resolution

Architecture improvements:
- Created CredentialResolver to centralize external credential provider logic
- Eliminates 4x duplicated credential fetching code across protocols
- Supports DelineaSecretServer, ClickstudiosPasswordState, OnePassword, VaultOpenbao
- Handles default credential fallback logic in one place

Also:
- Placeholder for AI Security Scan in Tools menu (implementation next)

Co-authored-by: Ryan Lence <lenceai@users.noreply.github.com>

security_flags.reason: credential and crypto paths need human review regardless of intent

triage.rationale: RDP span-all-screens is real user value; reimplement spanning atop our ported RDP code. Skip CredentialResolver refactor — security-sensitive churn, no bug it fixes.

votes.concern: The commit cannot compile because FrmSecurityScan is missing; it also duplicates existing multimonitor support and adds incomplete, unused credential logic.
votes.reason: Our fork already implements persisted, tested RDP multimonitor behavior; this patch adds a broken parallel path, dead resolver code, unsupported providers, and no tests.

votes.concern: The proposed CredentialResolver lacks PasswordSafe and LAPS providers from our fork, risking severe credential resolution regressions for those services.
votes.reason: RDP multi-monitor spanning is highly valuable, but the credential resolution code must be manually adapted to include our fork's existing providers.

dissent: codex: REJECT - Our fork already implements persisted, tested RDP multimonitor behavior; this patch adds a broken parallel path, dead resolver code, unsupported providers, and no tests.
gemini: NEEDS_HUMAN - RDP multi-monitor spanning is highly valuable, but the credential resolution code must be manually adapted to include our fork's existing providers.
